title: AION 2 Leveling: Faction Routes to Level 45
description: Follow the AION 2 Global campaign to level 45 with faction routes, dungeon milestones, and fixes for progression blockers.
summary: Follow the AION 2 Global campaign to level 45 with faction routes, dungeon milestones, and fixes for progression blockers.
quickAnswer: Global’s launch level cap is 45. Follow the main story and complete nearby objectives when they meet the next progression requirement. Finish remaining story unlocks after reaching the cap.

toc.title: Level toward Global's launch cap of 45
Elyos: main story first, nearby requirements second

workflow.title: Resume the campaign at the actual gate
workflow.caption: Follow your faction’s campaign and resolve the next progression gate.

steps.label: Choose your faction's campaign
steps.description: Elyos follow their journal toward Verteron; Asmodians use their own Altgard destinations.

steps.label: Read the next requirement
steps.description: Open the current objective and distinguish character level, Ascension, quest completion and equipment.

steps.label: Use nearby accepted content
steps.description: Group nearby objectives that satisfy the current progression requirement.

steps.label: Return and review rewards
steps.description: Turn in the campaign step, equip useful rewards and inspect newly available skills.

steps.label: Finish the story at 45
steps.description: Reaching the cap does not complete remaining campaign objectives or every activity's entry requirements.
